emma: New webinar pitch: 'Global Demo Day: serving demos across regions'. Goal: show a single demo running in eu/us/apac with regional fallbacks and localized CTAs. Target: June 2. Draft abstract below.

emma: Draft abstract: Walk through building a demo that feels local: low-latency routing, regional model variants, and ops playbooks for timezone rehearsals. Short benchmarks + two mini live demos (EU and APAC). Audience: platform and product engineers.

josh: solid. adding a short customer vignette would help — someone who ran demos in 3 regions.

priya: I can source a customer quote and handle localization of slides (EN/FR/JP). available May 20-30 for rehearsals.

lucas: I'll own benchmarks and the routing diagram. keep metrics simple: p50/p95 per region + cross-region failover delta.

emma: proposed speaker split: framing + customer vignette (emma+priya), benchmarks (lucas), live region demos + failover (josh). lucas can run the poll?

lucas: sure. poll: "Which region is your priority?" options: NA/EU/APAC.

emma: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00 - Welcome + goals (emma) 4m
04:00 - Customer vignette: multi-region lessons (priya) 6m
10:00 - Benchmarks: region breakdown (lucas) 8m
18:00 - Poll (lucas) 1m
19:00 - Live demo: EU instance (josh) 8m
27:00 - Live demo: APAC instance + failover (josh) 8m
35:00 - Ops checklist: timezone rehearsals & checklist (priya) 5m
40:00 - Q&A (panel) 20m
```

emma: rehearsals: tech-only May 22 08:00 PT (covers APAC window), full run May 29 16:00 PT (covers EU/NA). confirm?

priya: May 22 ok for me. May 29 confirmed.

lucas: confirmed both. will post per-region numbers by Mon.

josh: demo needs: pinned images for each region, IP whitelists for EU/APAC runners, and short test prompts. I'll post prompts.

sched-bot: Calendar slots created: Tech dry run 2026-05-22 08:00 PT, Full run 2026-05-29 16:00 PT. Reminders set.

emma: marketing copy drafts:
H1: "Global Demo Day: run live LLM demos that feel local"
Subhead: "Regional routing, benchmarks, and a reproducible ops playbook."
CTA: "Reserve your spot" + field: "Region".

josh: prefer shorter H1: 'Global Demo Day: local demos, global reach'.

priya: will localize CTA translations and prepare follow-up template in FR/JP.

emma: preflight checklist (short): slides + localized variants, pinned demo images + shas, per-region telemetry dashboards, routing policy + fallback list, rehearsal recordings.

lucas: I'll add a slide comparing cost/latency per region and expected failover delta.

emma: owners: slides/emma+priya, benchmarks/lucas, demos/josh, host/emma. I'll draft registration page and share links.

priya: putting customer vignette and slide translations in drive now.

emma: great — thanks team. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the rehearsal checklist doc. :globe_with_meridians:
